description.value: Fernie Distillers is a small-batch craft distillery producing gin, vodka, and liqueurs in downtown Fernie, with each bottle hand-filled and labeled on-site. The distillery operates a cocktail bar and tasting room, offers booked distillery tours on Fridays and Saturdays, and hosts a rotating calendar of community events. Their spirits take their names from local history — prospecting, mining, and bootlegging — rooted in the Elk Valley's past.
